description_en: Retrieves the details of a media producing job, including the job status, timeline, template, and data
description_zh: 获取剪辑合成作业的详细信息，包括剪辑合成任务的任务状态、时间线、模板及数据等
name: GetMediaProducingJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media producing job
parameters.name: job_id

ClipsParam.description_en: The template parameters of the media producing job
ClipsParam.description_zh: 剪辑合成作业对应的模板参数

Code.description_en:
The error code of the media producing job.
<notice>Check this field when the job fails.></notice>
Code.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业错误码
<notice>作业失败时关注该字段></notice>

CompleteTime.description_en:
The time when the media producing job was completed, in UTC.

Format: "YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"
CompleteTime.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业完成时间，格式为utc时间。

格式为："YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the media producing job was created, in UTC.

Format: "YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"
CreateTime.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业创建时间，格式为utc时间。

格式为："YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"

Duration.description_en:
The duration of the output media asset.
<notice>This field has a value only when the producing job succeeds and the output media asset type is audio or video.></notice>
Duration.description_zh:
输出成品的时长
<notice>当合成任务成功且输出成品的类型为音视频时，该字段有值。></notice>

JobId.description_en: The ID of the media producing job

MediaId.description_en: The resource ID of the output media asset

MediaURL.description_en: The resource file URL of the output media asset

Message.description_en:
The error message of the media producing job.

<notice>Check this field when the job fails.></notice>
Message.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业错误信息

<notice>作业失败时关注该字段></notice>
Message.example: The specified "Width_Height" has exceeded maximum value.

ModifiedTime.description_en:
The time when the media producing job was last modified, in UTC.

Format: "YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"
ModifiedTime.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业修改时间，格式为utc时间。

格式为："YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the cloud editing project

Status.description_en:
The status of the media producing job. Valid values:

Init: init state.
Queuing: queuing.
Processing: processing.
Success: succeeded.
Failed: failed
Status.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业状态，取值可能为如下值：

Init （初始状态）
Queuing（排队中）
Processing（处理中）
Success（成功）
Failed（失败）

SubJobMaterials.description_en: If this media producing job is a subtask of a batch intelligent one-click video production job, this field returns the material information used by the subtask, such as the narration text and title
SubJobMaterials.description_zh: 当该剪辑任务是批量智能一键成片的子任务，返回子任务用到的口播文案、标题等素材信息
SubJobMaterials.example: {"Title": "标题", "SpeechText": "批量智能一键成片口播文案"}

TemplateId.description_en: The template ID of the media producing job
TemplateId.description_zh: 剪辑合成作业对应的模板Id

Timeline.description_en: The timeline of the media producing job
Timeline.description_zh: 剪辑合成作业对应的时间线

UserData.description_en: The custom settings in JSON format

VodMediaId.description_en: If the output of the media producing job is delivered to ApsaraVideo VOD, the output is registered as a VOD media asset. The vodMediaId is the media asset ID in VOD
VodMediaId.description_zh: 如果剪辑任务的成片输出到VOD，成片会注册成一个VOD的媒资，vodMediaId 即该媒资在VOD的媒资ID
